==Walkthrough==
{{Checklist|*Talk to [[Romeo]] in [[Varrock Square]]. {{Chat option|1Perhaps I could help to find her for you?|1Yes, ok, I'll let her know.}}
*Talk to [[Juliet]] on the upper floor balcony of the mansion west of [[Varrock west bank]]. {{Chat option|1|1}} or she will provide you a letter if [[Recipe for Disaster]] is incomplete.
*Give Juliet's letter to [[Romeo]]. {{Chat option|4}}
*Talk to [[Father Lawrence]] in the church east of the [[Varrock Palace]].
*If you don't already have [[cadava berries]], you can pick them directly west of the [[South-east Varrock mine]].
*Talk to the [[Apothecary]] south of Varrock west bank. {{Chat option|2Talk about something else.|1Talk about Romeo & Juliet.}} ({{Chat option|2Talk about something else.|2Talk about Romeo & Juliet.}} If you have done [[Ratcatchers]], {{Chat option|3Talk about something else.|2Talk about Romeo & Juliet.}} If you have done [[A Tail of Two Cats]].)
*Give the potion to [[Juliet]].
*Go back to [[Romeo]] and tell him to meet Juliet in the crypt.
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''}}
